title: Simple Sprout Shop Logo
tests: Produces a usable simple logo combining a clear mark and a readable business name.

faults.what: The shop name is misspelled as 'Little Sprut', missing the 'o' in 'Sprout'.

judge.summary: The simple green sprout logo on white matches the requested style, but the shop name is misspelled.

must_haves.item: A recognizable, simple green sprout sits above the name.
must_haves.why: A simple green stem with three leaves is centered above the text.
The background is plain white without scenery or decoration.

must_haves.item: The square image contains a flat logo, not a photograph or merchandise mockup.
must_haves.why: The square image shows a flat sprout symbol and text, with no photographic or mockup elements.
